Venture.title: Venture
Venture.description: Represents a venture within the EveCount portfolio.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Venture entity.

sector.description: The sector the venture operates in (e.g., FinTech, Health).

status.description: The current status of the venture (e.g., Live).

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Represents a general application or submission to EveCount. This entity captures inbound interest for venture pitches, incubator applications, career inquiries, or partnerships. The form should dynamically adjust based on the 'applicationType', showing only the fields relevant to that inquiry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Submission entity.

applicationType.description: The type of application being submitted. This field dictates which other fields are relevant and required.

visionPitch.description: For a 'Venture Pitch', this is the core vision, problem, or challenge. For an 'Incubator Application', this is a statement of interest and domain expertise.

status.description: The workflow status of the submission.

companyName.description: Name of the company. Primarily for 'Venture Pitches' and 'Partnership Inquiries'.

submitterName.description: Name of the person who submitted the application.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone number of the submitter.

portfolioUrl.description: A URL to a portfolio, LinkedIn, or GitHub profile. Crucial for 'Incubator Application' and optional for 'Career Inquiry'.

resumeUrl.description: A URL to a resume or CV. Required for 'Career Inquiry'.

roleInterest.description: The role or area of interest. Required for 'Career Inquiry'.

partnershipInterest.description: For a 'Partnership Inquiry', this field should capture the specific business challenge or interest in partnering (e.g., Service Partner, Event Sponsor).

message.description: A general message or cover letter, primarily for 'Career Inquiry'.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information and role within the application.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth, which should match the document ID.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

role.description: The user's role, which determines their access level.

OutreachProposal.title: Outreach Proposal
OutreachProposal.description: Represents a proactive outreach proposal generated by an Execution agent. This is an auditable asset within the Clear-Box framework.

companyName.description: The target company for the outreach.

sourceUrl.description: The URL of the news article or trend that triggered this proposal (The External Pulse).

status.description: The current status of the proposal.

proposalTitle.description: The title of the generated proposal.

proposalBody.description: The full body content of the generated proposal.

strategicRationale.description: The 'Why' defined by the agent. Explains the correlation between the external pulse and the proposed action (The Traceable Rationale).

agentId.description: The unique identifier of the agent that generated this proposal (e.g., 'ai-strategist').

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the proposal was created.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: Represents a data source (e.g., RSS feed, subreddit) for the Intelligence cluster to monitor. Can be suggested by agents or humans.

suggestedById.description: UID of user or Agent ID (e.g. 'ai-seeker') who suggested it.

suggestedBy.description: The name of the user or agent.

AgentConversation.title: Agent Conversation
AgentConversation.description: The entire chat history between a user and a specific command center agent.

userId.description: The UID of the user having the conversation.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the Clear-Box Intelligence Blueprint. It uses a flat, non-hierarchical collection model to ensure that agent-driven actions are independent and auditable. Each primary entity (ventures, submissions, users, proposals, sources) is segregated into its own collection to enforce strict, granular security rules and maintain data integrity. This design facilitates the core logic of `Action = (External Pulse) + (Internal Resonance) + (Traceable Rationale)` by creating clear, referenceable data points for each step of an agent's operation. For example, an OutreachProposal can be directly traced back to its triggering Source, and the agent's ID is stamped on every action, providing a clear audit trail for all operations within the Clear-Box Dashboard.
